proposal.summary: Multiple SQL injection vulnerabilities in Hospital Management System v4.0: POST parameter 'searchdata' in doctor search, GET parameter 'viewid' in view-patient.php, POST parameter 'bs' when adding medical history, POST parameter 'patname' when adding a patient, and POST parameter 'cpass' in admin change-password are all reported vulnerable. sqlmap evidence shows UNION, boolean- and time-based injections and database enumeration (MySQL/MariaDB).
proposal.cwe_quote: ?searchdata parameter is vulnerable to SQL injection under the search feature in the doctor login.
